hotels.title: Portugal Algarve Adventure near Vilamoura Beach with Seafront Restaurant
hotels.description: Mere moments from the beautiful beaches of Vilamoura, Crowne Plaza Vilamoura - Algarve, an IHG Hotel, promises a picturesque Portuguese surf and sand stay. A luxurious experience awaits you, with delectable local specialties at Cataplana restaurant or chilled cocktails by the pool. Treat yourself to a soothing spa treatment or head out to sun-drenched strips of coast to lounge by crashing waves before exploring vibrant bars and restaurants only a few steps away.

hotels.title: HYATT REGENCY VILAMOURA ALGARVE LPP
hotels.description: Set in Vilamoura’s polished marina district, this refined retreat places you moments from the yacht-lined waterfront and the golden sweep of Praia da Falésia. The Roman ruins of Cerro da Vila and the lively bars of Avenida Tivoli are close by, while Faro Airport sits around 30 minutes away by car. Inside, spacious rooms open to balconies and contemporary interiors, with a spa, outdoor pool and fitness centre on hand. Dining spans Mediterranean plates and relaxed drinks, while nearby golf courses include the championship fairways of Victoria and Millennium
